sources.title: GPS and Telling Time
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Galileo 偽距：時鐘修正與殘差追蹤
related.titleEn: Galileo pseudorange: clock correction and residual tracking
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 2.99792458 m pseudorange bias 與 29.9792458 m pseudorange bias，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 2.99792458 m pseudorange bias and 29.9792458 m pseudorange bias, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋8 m residual與4 m residual，建立galileo_corrections.csv、歷元/符號表、殘差回代，並完成以下驗收：5 m殘差門檻第二例通過；仍需多衛星幾何與接收器時鐘聯合解算。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 8 m residual and 4 m residual; create galileo_corrections.csv, epoch/sign table and residual substitution; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second meets a5 m residual limit; multi-satellite geometry and receiver-clock estimation remain necessary.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 未校正時間偏差dt產生偽距偏差c*dt；同一接收器時鐘偏差是共同未知量，不能各衛星任意刪除。 展開基準式 299792458*10/1000000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：由距離除c還原10/100 ns；四衛星解算需共同位置三維加時鐘四未知量。 將兩條推導一起存入 gps_clock.csv、共同時鐘欄、偽距殘差。
從原理 偽距包含幾何距離、接收與衛星時鐘及傳播偏差；修正要保留符號與時間基準。 展開基準式 30-22；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將修正與殘差加回30 m；用同一歷元標記，不能把另一歷元修正直接混用。 將兩條推導一起存入 galileo_corrections.csv、歷元/符號表、殘差回代。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Uncorrected timing biasdt creates pseudorange biasc*dt; a receiver clock bias is a shared unknown rather than an arbitrary per-satellite subtraction., expand baseline expression 299792458*10/1000000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Divide range bias byc to recover10/100 ns; four-satellite positioning includes three position unknowns plus one clock term. Save both derivations with gps_clock.csv, common-clock column and pseudorange residuals.

Starting from Pseudorange contains geometry, receiver/satellite clocks and propagation terms; corrections require explicit signs and time references., expand baseline expression 30-22; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Add correction and residual back to30 m; retain the epoch and never mix corrections from different epochs. Save both derivations with galileo_corrections.csv, epoch/sign table and residual substitution.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CCSDS CFDP：缺段重傳與檔案完成證據
related.titleEn: CCSDS CFDP: missing-segment retransmission and completion evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 2.99792458 m pseudorange bias 與 29.9792458 m pseudorange bias，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 2.99792458 m pseudorange bias and 29.9792458 m pseudorange bias, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋5000 payload bytes retransmitted與20000 payload bytes retransmitted，建立cfdp_missing.csv、缺段位圖、重組雜湊與完成判定記錄，並完成以下驗收：若重傳預算10000 byte，5段情境可通過而20段不行；兩者都要等覆蓋完整且雜湊一致才標完成。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 5000 payload bytes retransmitted and 20000 payload bytes retransmitted; create cfdp_missing.csv, coverage bitmap, reassembly hashes and completion decisions; apply this acceptance decision: For a10000-byte retransmission budget only5 missing segments fit; both scenarios require complete coverage and matching hashes before marking completion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 未校正時間偏差dt產生偽距偏差c*dt；同一接收器時鐘偏差是共同未知量，不能各衛星任意刪除。 展開基準式 299792458*10/1000000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：由距離除c還原10/100 ns；四衛星解算需共同位置三維加時鐘四未知量。 將兩條推導一起存入 gps_clock.csv、共同時鐘欄、偽距殘差。
從原理 選擇性缺段恢復只重送缺少範圍，完成仍須位元組連續與完整性檢查；收到最後一段並不等於完整檔案。 展開基準式 5*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用0..999段索引集合求差集，排序為缺失區間；重組前後計算雜湊，確認重傳計數未包含已收到段。 將兩條推導一起存入 cfdp_missing.csv、缺段位圖、重組雜湊與完成判定記錄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Uncorrected timing biasdt creates pseudorange biasc*dt; a receiver clock bias is a shared unknown rather than an arbitrary per-satellite subtraction., expand baseline expression 299792458*10/1000000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Divide range bias byc to recover10/100 ns; four-satellite positioning includes three position unknowns plus one clock term. Save both derivations with gps_clock.csv, common-clock column and pseudorange residuals.

Starting from Selective recovery retransmits missing ranges; completion still requires contiguous bytes and integrity checks, so receiving the last segment does not establish completion., expand baseline expression 5*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Subtract received indices from0..999, sort missing ranges and hash reassembled data; ensure retransmission counts exclude already received segments. Save both derivations with cfdp_missing.csv, coverage bitmap, reassembly hashes and completion decisions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
